def main():
    s = input().strip()
    ans = 0
    i = 0
    n = len(s)
    while i < n:
        start = i
        current = s[i]
        while i < n and s[i] == current:
            i += 1
        run_length = i - start
        if run_length % 2 == 0:
            ans += 1
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
